about: Photos shown on complaint cards. `photos` maps a ticket id to a file (only for the ticket it actually shows). `categories` gives a synthetic stand-in image per complaint category for tickets whose source data has no photo; every such image is labelled as synthetic on the card.

pothole.alt: Synthetic image of a water-filled pothole on a city road

garbage.alt: Synthetic image of overflowing garbage beside a roadside bin

streetlight.alt: Synthetic image of a broken street light at dusk

drain.alt: Synthetic image of a blocked roadside drain with stagnant water
